outfit: Opaque lined cream satin square-neck camisole with broad straps and brown lace edging, high-waisted brown satin lounge shorts, a light cream robe loosely behind the elbows, tiny amber earrings. Adult lingerie-inspired lounge fashion, bare shoulders and arms, fully covered chest and pelvis; no armor.
custom: 1024x1536 vertical. Preserve the approved adult face and haircut. Both complete hands visibly connect to their respective forearms, with one thumb and four separate natural fingers each. No weapons, text, logos or extra figures.
